implementation_summary: Fixes the three blocking security defects from code-review-final.json (CR-002, CR-003, CR-004). CR-003 (src/codemie/service/conversation/a2ui_intake.py): validate_a2ui_intake now semantically re-validates the submitted answer against the surface the SERVER stored, after the existing envelope/size/existence/already-answered checks. New helpers index the stored surface's components (across all updateComponents envelopes) and enforce: action.name must be one of the Button action.event.name values the surface offers (a surface declaring no Button event names accepts any name -- documented in the code, since such a surface has no server-known vocabulary); every data_model key must be bound by a component via value:{'path':'/<id>'} (unknown key -> 422; nested paths '/a/b' whitelist only their root key and get no per-value check, because that key holds a subtree, not one field); ChoicePicker values must be a list of strings drawn from the declared options[].value, with at most one item when variant=='mutuallyExclusive'; TextField values must be strings no longer than A2UI_MAX_FIELD_VALUE_LEN=4096 and, when the component declares validationRegexp, must fullmatch it via the `regex` module under a hard 0.1 s wall-clock timeout (ReDoS defense ported verbatim from the deleted core/interactive.py, including the pattern-length cap and the 'no timeout-capable engine -> skip, never run untrusted patterns through stdlib re' fallback); CheckBox values must be bool; DateTimeInput values must be ISO 8601 and inside the component's min/max when those parse to a comparable kind. All violations raise ExtendedHTTPException(code=422) with a field-named message, matching the neighbouring checks. CR-002 (src/codemie/agents/tools/interactive/request_user_input.py + src/codemie/core/a2ui/adapter.py): new protocol constants MAX_SURFACE_COMPONENTS=100 and MAX_SURFACE_PAYLOAD_BYTES=65536 live next to WIRE_VERSION in adapter.py; RequestUserInputTool._check_surface_bounds enforces both BEFORE build_surface_envelopes/validation, raising ValueError (-> ToolException) so the model retries with a smaller surface instead of persisting a 775 KB tree into history forever. CR-004 (src/codemie/rest_api/handlers/assistant_handlers.py): _validate_a2ui_action now runs when EITHER a2ui_action or a2ui_data_model is present, and rejects a2uiDataModel submitted without a2uiAction with a 422 ('A2UI data model requires the matching A2UI action'), because conversation_service persists a2ui_data_model unconditionally; the handler also consumes validate_a2ui_intake's return value (the server's own stored surface record) instead of discarding it.
